note: p95 wall time per frame in ms including GPU readback. `default` is a placeholder (one 60 fps frame), NOT a measurement. Real per-style budgets are written by `node tools/bench.mjs --update-budgets --runs 3 --write` on a real GPU; `reference` then names the device. styles[id] is a number (p95) or { p95, p50?, max? }.
